# Start Forcing Throttle

Source: [4451](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4451); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Forcing Throttle](../../api/actions/start-forcing-throttle.md).

<a id="wiki-4451-n1"></a>

- Forcing throttle sets input bounds, not velocity; minimum 1 forces full directional movement while maximum 0 prevents that direction, and minimum 0 permits stopping.
